zh.lead: 威利是 Veli 里的 AI 力量训练教练，替上班族排好什么时候练、在哪练、练什么。你只管到场。
zh.planIntro: 明早 7:10 出门，健身房 6:30 就开了。动作排好了：
zh.planCap: 威利前一晚发来的第一练：六组动作，加上热身和收尾，12 分钟做完。
zh.whatLead: 先把三个基本动作练稳，再慢慢加重量。每个动作都有更容易的做法，从你做得到的那一档开始。
zh.howLead: 说一次你想要什么，剩下的它来排；练完只说具体哪里变好了。
zh.branchAlt: 一周七天的枝：周一、周三、周五、周日练了力量，长出实心叶；周四完成了一件小事，长出浅色叶；周二、周六没练，只是节点
zh.branchCap: 练了力量长一片实心叶，完成一件小事长一片浅色叶；没练的日子只是一个节点，不扣分，也不掉叶子。
zh.firstLead: 告诉威利你想练什么、一周有几天，剩下的它来排。
zh.popNote: 登录后直接进入今天的安排；第一次来，先确认年龄和数据怎么用，一屏完成。扫右边的码，可以在手机上打开。
zh.codeLabel: 扫码在手机上打开这一页

en.h1: Get strong for the long run
en.lead: Veli, an AI strength coach, plans when, where, and what you train around a full-time job. You just show up.
en.planIntro: You leave at 7:10 tomorrow and the gym opens at 6:30. Your session is ready:
en.planCap: Sent by Veli the night before. Your first session: six sets plus a warm-up and a cool-down, done in 12 minutes.
en.whatTitle: What to train: three moves first
en.whatLead: Get three basic moves solid, then add weight slowly. Each move has an easier version, so start at the level you can do.
en.howLead: Say what you want once and Veli plans the rest. After each session, it tells you exactly what improved.
en.branchAlt: A week as a branch: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday had strength sessions and grew solid leaves; Thursday had a small win and grew a light leaf; Tuesday and Saturday are plain nodes
en.branchCap: A strength session grows a solid leaf; a small win grows a light one. Days off are just nodes: no penalty, no lost leaves.
en.firstLead: Tell Veli what you want to train and how many days a week. It plans the rest.
en.popNote: Signing in takes you straight to today’s plan. First time? Confirm your age and how your data is used, all on one screen. Scan the code to open it on your phone.
en.codeLabel: Scan to open this page on your phone

moves.name: 深蹲
moves.line: 从徒手深蹲开始，能稳稳做 10 次以后，换成高脚杯深蹲。

moves.name: 俯卧撑
moves.line: 先扶着桌边做，再到膝盖着地，最后做标准俯卧撑。

moves.name: 划船
moves.line: 用一只哑铃或一瓶水做单臂划船，后背发力，肩膀放松。

steps.title: 说出你想要的
steps.line: 练什么、一周几天、身上有没有旧伤。说一次，威利记住。

steps.title: 威利提前排好
steps.line: 动作、组数、路线、开门时间，前一晚就放在你手边。不知道的，它会直说不知道。

steps.title: 练完，长一片叶子
steps.line: 只告诉你具体哪里变好了，比如「比上周多 2 次」。误差内的波动，不算进步。

moves.name: Squat
moves.line: Start with bodyweight squats. Once you can do 10 steady reps, switch to goblet squats.

moves.name: Push-up
moves.line: Start with your hands on a table edge, then on your knees, then a full push-up.

moves.name: Row
moves.line: Do one-arm rows with a dumbbell or a water bottle. Pull with your back and keep your shoulders loose.

steps.title: Say what you want
steps.line: What to train, how many days a week, any old injuries. Say it once and Veli remembers.

steps.title: Veli plans ahead
steps.line: Moves, sets, route, and opening hours, ready the night before. When it doesn’t know something, it says so.

steps.title: Finish and grow a leaf
steps.line: You hear exactly what improved, such as “2 more reps than last week.” Normal day-to-day swings don’t count as progress.
